name: anhydrous citric acid + dextrose + trisodium
uses: Indications and Usage Anticoagulant Citrate Dextrose Solution, Solution A, U.S.P. (ACD-A), is intended for use as an anticoagulant in the extracorporeal blood processing with Autologous PRP Systems in production of platelet rich plasma (PRP). Refer to the manufacturer's Operator's Manual of the Autologous PRP System for the Directions for Use.
pediatric: Pediatric Use The safety and effectiveness of ACD-A in children have not been established.
contra: Contraindications NOT FOR DIRECT INTRAVENOUS INFUSION
